name: S3 Bucket
description: Create, delete, or idempotently ensure an S3 bucket exists, as a materializable Dagster asset -- the Airflow S3CreateBucketOperator/S3DeleteBucketOperator equivalent.
author: Dagster Community

outputs.description: MaterializeResult with bucket name, action, and existed/created status in metadata

bucket_name.description: S3 bucket name (globally unique across all of AWS).
bucket_name.label: Bucket Name

action.description: 'ensure_exists' (default): create the bucket if missing; a no-op if it already exists and is owned by the caller (idempotent). 'create': expects the bucket NOT to already exist; fails loudly (BucketAlreadyExists / BucketAlreadyOwnedByYou) if it does. 'delete': idempotent -- deleting an already-absent bucket succeeds.
action.label: Action

aws_region.description: AWS region for bucket creation, e.g. 'us-west-2'. Unset uses boto3's default region chain. Ignored for action='delete'.
aws_region.label: Aws Region

force_delete.description: action='delete' only. S3 refuses to delete a non-empty bucket by default (safety). Set True to first delete every object/version/delete-marker in the bucket, then the bucket itself -- destructive and irreversible.
force_delete.label: Force Delete

deps.description: Upstream Dagster asset keys for lineage.
deps.label: Deps

owners.description: Asset owners -- team names ('team:analytics') or email addresses.
owners.label: Owners

asset_tags.description: Additional key-value tags applied to the asset in the Dagster catalog.
asset_tags.label: Asset Tags

kinds.description: Asset kinds for the catalog. Auto-includes 'aws' and 's3' if empty.
kinds.label: Kinds

retry_policy_max_retries.description: Max retries on asset failure. Defines a RetryPolicy.
retry_policy_max_retries.label: Retry Policy Max Retries
